config.label: Chroma search
config.emptyText: Run the prefilled body to page through this collection. Add query_embeddings or query_id for similarity search, query_text or where_document to filter on document text, and where or ids to narrow the fetch.

config.ariaLabel: Two-dimensional PCA projection of this collection's embeddings
config.instructions: Arrow keys move the selection, Home and End jump to the edges, plus and minus zoom, 0 resets, Escape clears. Click a point to select it; drag to pan; hold Alt, Ctrl, or Cmd with the wheel to zoom.

config.ariaLabel: Neighbor rankings for one record compared across the l2, cosine, and inner-product distance spaces
config.instructions: Left and right arrows move between distance columns, up and down change the anchor record, Enter anchors on the top neighbor of the focused column, and r resets. Click any card to re-anchor.
